volume_mode.description: The search volume calculation mode: monthly or average. It affects volume, traffic, and traffic value.

targets.description: A list of targets to do batch analysis.

ahrefs_rank.title: ahrefs_rank
ahrefs_rank.description: The strength of your target's backlink profile compared to the other websites in our database, with rank #1 being the strongest.

backlinks.title: backlinks
backlinks.description: The total number of links from other websites pointing to your target.

backlinks_dofollow.title: backlinks_dofollow
backlinks_dofollow.description: Links to your target that do not contain a “nofollow”, “ugc”, or “sponsored” value in their “rel” attribute. These links are also called “dofollow”.

backlinks_internal.title: backlinks_internal
backlinks_internal.description: The total number of internal links pointing to the target's pages.

backlinks_nofollow.title: backlinks_nofollow
backlinks_nofollow.description: Links to your target that contain a “nofollow”, “ugc”, or “sponsored” value in their “rel” attribute.

backlinks_redirect.title: backlinks_redirect
backlinks_redirect.description: Links pointing to your target via a redirect.

domain_rating.title: domain_rating
domain_rating.description: The strength of your target's backlink profile compared to the other websites in our database on a 100-point logarithmic scale.

ip.title: ip
ip.description: The IP address of the target.

linked_domains.title: linked_domains
linked_domains.description: The number of unique domains linked from your target.

linked_domains_dofollow.title: linked_domains_dofollow
linked_domains_dofollow.description: The number of unique domains linked from your target with followed links.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: The target mode used for the analysis. Depending on the selected mode (Exact URL, Path, Domain, Subdomains), different parts of the website will be analyzed.

org_cost.title: org_cost
org_cost.description: (10 units) The estimated value of your target’s monthly organic search traffic.

org_keywords.title: org_keywords
org_keywords.description: The total number of keywords that your target ranks for in the top 100 organic search results. When ranking for the same keyword across different locations in “All locations” mode, it's still counted as one keyword.

org_keywords_11_20.title: org_keywords_11_20
org_keywords_11_20.description: The total number of unique keywords for which your target's top organic ranking position is within the 11th to 20th results. When ranking for the same keyword across different locations in “All locations” mode, it's still counted as one keyword.

org_keywords_1_3.title: org_keywords_1_3
org_keywords_1_3.description: The total number of unique keywords for which your target's top organic ranking position is within the top 3 results. When ranking for the same keyword across different locations in “All locations” mode, it's still counted as one keyword.

org_keywords_21_50.title: org_keywords_21_50
org_keywords_21_50.description: The total number of unique keywords for which your target's top organic ranking position is within the 21st to 50th results. When ranking for the same keyword across different locations in “All locations” mode, it's still counted as one keyword.

org_keywords_4_10.title: org_keywords_4_10
org_keywords_4_10.description: The total number of unique keywords for which your target's top organic ranking position is within the 4th to 10th results. When ranking for the same keyword across different locations in “All locations” mode, it's still counted as one keyword.

org_keywords_51_plus.title: org_keywords_51_plus
org_keywords_51_plus.description: The total number of unique keywords for which your target's top organic ranking position is the 51st result or higher. When ranking for the same keyword across different locations in “All locations” mode, it's still counted as one keyword.

org_traffic.title: org_traffic
org_traffic.description: (10 units) The estimated number of monthly visits that your target gets from organic search.

org_traffic_top_by_country.title: org_traffic_top_by_country
org_traffic_top_by_country.description: (10 units) Top countries by traffic with corresponding traffic values. (Currently only a single element is being returned with the country with the most traffic.)

outgoing_links.title: outgoing_links
outgoing_links.description: The total number of links from your target to other domains.

outgoing_links_dofollow.title: outgoing_links_dofollow
outgoing_links_dofollow.description: The total number of followed links from your target to other domains.

paid_ads.title: paid_ads
paid_ads.description: The total number of unique ads of a target website or URL in paid search results.

paid_cost.title: paid_cost
paid_cost.description: (10 units) The estimated cost of your target’s monthly paid search traffic.

paid_keywords.title: paid_keywords
paid_keywords.description: The total number of keywords that your target ranks for in paid search results. When ranking for the same keyword across different locations in “All locations” mode, it's still counted as one keyword.

paid_traffic.title: paid_traffic
paid_traffic.description: (10 units) The estimated number of monthly visits that your target gets from paid search.

protocol.title: protocol
protocol.description: The protocol of the target. Possible values: `both`, `http`, `https`.

refdomains.title: refdomains
refdomains.description: (5 units) The total number of unique domains linking to your target.

refdomains_dofollow.title: refdomains_dofollow
refdomains_dofollow.description: (5 units) The number of unique domains with links to your target that do not contain a “nofollow”, “ugc”, or “sponsored” value in their “rel” attribute. These links are also called “dofollow”.

refdomains_nofollow.title: refdomains_nofollow
refdomains_nofollow.description: (5 units) The number of unique domains that only have links to your target containing a “nofollow”, “ugc”, or “sponsored” value in their “rel” attribute.

refips.title: refips
refips.description: The number of unique IP addresses with at least one domain pointing to your target. Several domains can share one IP address.

refips_subnets.title: refips_subnets
refips_subnets.description: The number of c-class IP networks (AAA.BBB.CCC.DDD) with at least one link to your target. Example: 151.80.39.61 is the website IP address where 151.80.39.XXX is the subnet.

url.title: url
url.description: The URL of the analyzed target.

url_rating.title: url_rating
url_rating.description: URL Rating (UR) shows the strength of your target page's backlink profile on a 100-point logarithmic scale. If you analyze a domain, the homepage's UR is shown.

url.description: The URL of the analyzed target.

mode.description: The target mode used for the analysis.
